admin.quality_hint: Problem: 2+ seller-fault refunds, 3+ complaints or under 50% completed (from 3 orders). Good: 3+ orders, 80%+ completed, no refunds or complaints.

admin.revenue_note: Revenue = commission on online orders + prepayment on cash orders; completed orders, bucketed by creation month.

admin.tax_note: Invoices are for BMG’s commission (VAT is included in the commission). BMG files nothing with the tax office itself: staff submit the invoice through SoliqOnline or an operator with an e-signature and record the reference. Confirm with an accountant: VAT on the commission and the new tax-agent rules from 12 Dec 2026.
